_comment: SAPM Service Level Objectives — authoritative SLO definitions for Alpha mainnet launch gate.

slos.description: Sui RPC endpoint is reachable and returns valid JSON-RPC responses
slos.sli: Percentage of JSON-RPC health probe requests returning HTTP 200 with a valid result field

slos.description: Forecast-to-trade agent loop completes a full cycle without error
slos.sli: Percentage of agent loop iterations that complete without an unhandled exception or circuit-breaker trip

slos.description: Trade and market-management transactions are executed successfully on-chain
slos.sli: Percentage of submitted transactions with execution status 'success' within 30 seconds

slos.description: Agent forecast generation completes within the latency budget
slos.sli: p99 latency of forecast generation measured from input receipt to decision output

slos.description: Markets frontend route returns HTTP 200 and renders without JS error
slos.sli: Percentage of synthetic monitor probe requests returning HTTP 200 with page-level JS health

errorBudgetPolicy: When any SLO error budget is > 50% consumed in its window, a freeze on non-critical feature work is triggered until budget is restored above 50%.
reviewCadence: Weekly SLO review during on-call handoff. Thresholds reviewed quarterly.
